title: An AI system improves a Chan–Lam coupling reaction
summary: The system identified TEMPO as a useful additive for coupling primary sulfonamides; chemists reproduced yield improvements in 11 of 14 substrate pairs at bench scale. The work retains human supervision and specialized infrastructure; independent reproducibility and generalization remain to be checked.

evidence.tested: Over two cycles in an automated lab, yields improved for 88% of boronic acids and 83% of sulfonamides tested (mean 16.6% to 25.2%); human chemists repeated representative reactions at bench scale, with higher yields for 11 of 14 substrate pairs.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material
evidence.ai_role: GPT-5.4 connected to Molecule.one Maria proposed, designed and analyzed experiments; humans steered prompts, selected proposals, made limited corrections and validated the final result.
